column3: AND WHEREAS it is necessary to establish an independent
institution to provide Parliament with budget analyses and
costings  that  it  can  rely  on  when  scrutinising  spending
proposals  and  making  public  finance  decisions  and  to
provide recognised political parties and independent groups
with costing analyses of proposals in their manifestos:
NOW THEREFORE, be it enacted by the Parliament of the
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:–
